claims.claim: Get 5 copies of good books for 20k & 10 copies for 33k.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a set of business/self-help books, but do not show pricing, quantity-per-bundle rules, or the exact number of copies/books included.
This is a motivational statement and is not verifiable from the photos.

risks.risk: Exact count of books in the set is not shown; pricing depends on how many titles/volumes you actually receive.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full stack from the side with the total number of books visible (or a hand-count/numbered lineup).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case smaller bundle (fewer books than expected) until the exact count is confirmed.

risks.risk: Completeness and internal condition (missing pages/chapters, torn pages, water damage) are not visible from spine-only photos.
risks.proof: A short video/clip flipping through 2–3 random books to show intact pages and no water damage/torn sections.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete/used heavily (as-not-fully-checked) until internal condition is confirmed.

risks.risk: Binding integrity (loose binding, spine cracks) and whether books open/hold properly are not visible.
risks.proof: A clip opening one book flat at the spine and showing the hinge/binding area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible weak binding (lower resale value) until binding condition is confirmed.

risks.risk: Writing/highlighting/notes inside can reduce value; not visible in the provided photos.
risks.proof: A photo of the inside pages (title page + one random chapter page) showing whether there is highlighting/pen marks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if there may be markings (worst-case for resale) until confirmed clean.

risks.risk: Edition/printing year and whether any volumes are missing dust covers/extra materials (if applicable) are not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of the copyright/edition page for 2–3 titles and a check for missing dust covers/extra inserts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used copies with unknown edition and missing extras until edition/materials are confirmed.

proof_requests: Confirm the exact number of books/volumes included in the bundle (show a full side view or count).
Send a short video flipping through 2–3 random books to confirm pages are complete and not water-damaged/torn.
Show a close-up/clip of the binding/spine hinge on at least one book (open flat).
Provide photos of inside pages (title page + one random chapter page) to check for highlighting/pen notes.
Send photos of the copyright/edition page for a few titles to confirm edition/printing year.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a set of business/self-help books, but key pricing drivers (exact count, completeness, internal condition, binding, edition) are not verifiable from the spine-only photos. Without those missing shots, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
